content.value: A hospital monitoring system uses the 8086 microprocessor to continuously monitor vital signs. The system needs to handle a timer interrupt to record vital signs every second which is invoked byNMI pin.
(i) Calculate the IVT address number for timer interrupt.

(ii) Design an interrupt handling system by interrupt controller with another two interrupts; an external interrupt for nurse call button inputs and sensor interrupts for abnormal readings such as high heart rate or low oxygen levels.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2023
